releases.summary: 0.5.79: verified stale Auto Stage recovery in Update ZIP plus correct current Cloud Update error reports
notes: Verified terminal Auto Stage recovery in UPDATE.bat with explicit consent, immutable backup, and trusted Windows Backend identity.
A nonterminal or mismatched Stage remains blocked. Never manually delete the ownership marker or MXFs.
STAGE_RECOVERY.bat can repair a legacy user installation before a Cloud Update retry.
Per-request detached installer logs show the real latest error, not historical Access denied.
Developer Git checkouts are protected from Cloud Installer migration.
Existing UI resumable update/progress and startup fixes retained.
Real target workstation/Win25 acceptance OPEN, public packages contain no private Team LINE/Google secrets.
